Landing.title:
Your work. Your time.
All in one place.
Landing.description: A clearer way to manage freelance projects, track your time, and bring your work to invoice. Built for independent engineers and small teams.
Landing.meta: SoloDesk — a clearer view of your freelance work
Landing.featureHeading:
Less admin.
More room for your craft.
Landing.featureDescription: A connected direction for your freelance day. These capabilities are planned; you can start with your account today.
Landing.projectsBody: Keep client work, tasks, and the next step together.
Landing.timeBody: Connect focused work to a project, without watching over anyone’s shoulder.
Landing.invoicesBody: Bring time and deliverables into a clear record of what you’ve earned.
Landing.workflowTitle:
A little more clarity.
At every step.
Landing.workTitle:
Start with the work.
Keep the context.
Landing.workBody: From a new brief to the final review, the planned project workflow keeps tasks and progress beside the client work they belong to.
Landing.timeWorkBody: The planned time and invoice workflow connects the hours you put in with the work you deliver. One considered flow, with the details in view.
Landing.closing:
Make space for
your best work.
Landing.closingBody: Create your SoloDesk account. Your projects, time, and invoices are the next chapter.
Landing.accountAvailable: Account access is available. Business tools are planned.
